product_description_excerpt: GoldenBasis makes modern back-office software for brokerages like Schwab or Fidelity, and we’re starting with asset transfers. Every year, $1.1 trillion in assets are transferred inefficiently between brokerages using decades-old software. Brokerages hire thousands of people to compensate, but still lose revenue because it’s hard for clients to transfer in their assets. GoldenBasis is solving this problem by automating back-office workflows with AI.
